claims.statement: Payment reminders arrive within five minutes of the selected time.
claims.reason: The delivery probe and latency measurements support the delivery deadline.
claims.title: Reminders arrive on time

claims.statement: A changed or deleted payment does not produce an outdated reminder.
claims.reason: A reminder contained the previous amount after the payment was updated.
claims.title: Reminders reflect current payments

claims.statement: Temporary delivery failures are retried without duplicate reminders.
claims.reason: The recovery job has not run for the deployed release.
claims.title: Delivery retries avoid duplicates

claims.statement: Notification workers can read only the payment data needed for delivery.
claims.method: Access policy analysis and production probe
claims.reason: The policy changed after its Claim Review; a successor review is needed.
claims.title: Workers access only necessary payment data

claims.statement: Delivery failures are detected and reported to the operations team.
claims.method: Monitoring rule and alert delivery job
claims.reason: The alert delivery job stopped reporting. Its last result does not establish current visibility.
claims.title: Delivery failures reach the operations team

claims.statement: Each reminder contains the payment name, current amount and due date.
claims.reason: Component tests passed for the source used to build the observed artifact; release lineage is verified.
claims.title: Reminders contain complete payment details

claims.statement: Notification workers use a restricted delivery credential.
claims.reason: The tested delivery scope is restricted, but one production instance reports an unrestricted scope.
claims.title: Workers use restricted delivery credentials
